mintAuthority.summary: TBILL is the share token of OpenEden's BVI-registered professional fund; mint/redeem is KYC-gated institutional subscription at NAV across five independent native deployments on Ethereum, Arbitrum, BNB Chain, Solana, and XRPL. Each EVM vault uses a UUPS proxy owned by a 24-hour TimelockController (proposed/executed by a chain-specific 4-of-5 Safe sharing the same five signers) with that Safe also holding maintainer() and controller DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE under an unbounded totalSupplyCap. Solana Token-2022 mint 4MmJVdwYN8LwvbGeCowYjSx7KoEi6BJWg8XXnW4fDDp6 retains an EOA mintAuthority (zero supply) and XRPL TBL issuer rJNE2NNz83GJYtWVLwMvchDWEon3huWnFn issues directly under a 2-of-3 SignerList.

controls.label: OpenEden fund issuance backend
controls.evidence: OpenEden's BVI Registered Professional Fund issues and redeems TBILL for KYC-verified institutional subscribers at NAV against BNY-custodied T-bills across all five authored native deployments; this issuer workflow is native issuance, not a bridge or cross-chain burn/mint route.

review.evidence: Reviewed across all five independent native issuance deployments at pinned 2026-11-27 blocks/slots/ledgers. On Ethereum (finalized block 26504747), Arbitrum (finalized block 527933933, zero supply), and BNB Chain (block 135992714, 18 decimals, 217,941,772.69 TBILL), each OpenEden UUPS proxy (implementations 0xc4545bf80f935894cbe138d86b506923dab7c048, 0x78365404fc5edabef6eca2f6b2f1ba1471727a07, and 0xf3c7bbd9f91de0664a3e2ec5063e45872da472d9 respectively; zero EIP-1967 admin slot) is now owned by a 24-hour (86400s) TimelockController (0x6e8559afd41f8f9971828aa8b0c25b65ca6a5567, 0x93794a1c593fd22acb106232f4422b405f2b7fcd, and 0x60df3ffaeac48b94c0dd174eadf6fa5860da791a). On each EVM chain, a chain-specific 4-of-5 Safe sharing the exact same five signers (0x8ec4dd2df01c188ac5a5d870029e9cbb820d5844 v1.3.0, 0xca7f64e77bc422b1913afb0065bfc0d8b3561bf3 v1.3.0, and 0x3ba6c5437232156baacba5c084c8a746e3217ed6 v1.4.1; zero modules, no guard) holds PROPOSER_ROLE, EXECUTOR_ROLE, and CANCELLER_ROLE on the Timelock, holds vault maintainer() (with totalSupplyCap = type(uint256).max), and holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on the vault controller. At finalized Solana slot 474453823, Token-2022 mint 4MmJVdwYN8LwvbGeCowYjSx7KoEi6BJWg8XXnW4fDDp6 retained EOA mintAuthority CPNEkz5SaAcWqGMezXTti39ekErzMpDCtuPMGw9tt4CZ with zero supply. At validated XRPL ledger 108600483, issuer rJNE2NNz83GJYtWVLwMvchDWEon3huWnFn retained direct TBL issuance under a 2-of-3 signer list. These uncapped native authorities support economicCapSemantics unbounded and authorityPosture concentrated-admin, with Protege daily/monthly administrator NAV reports and BVI FSC Registered Professional Fund supervision supporting reconciliation periodic and supervision prudential.
